name: Hophra
title: Pharaoh of Egypt
summary: Hophra (also known as Apries) was a pharaoh of Egypt from the 26th dynasty who reigned during the period around the fall of Jerusalem. He attempted to help Judah against Babylon but failed. The prophet Jeremiah prophesied that God would deliver Hophra into the hands of his enemies, just as he had delivered Zedekiah to Nebuchadnezzar.

keyEvents.title: Hophra's failed aid to Judah
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh Hophra sent an army from Egypt to help Jerusalem against the Babylonian siege, but the Egyptian army withdrew without achieving any lasting result.

keyEvents.title: Jeremiah's prophecy against Hophra
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah prophesied that God would deliver Pharaoh Hophra into the hands of his enemies, just as he had delivered Zedekiah, king of Judah, to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Ezekiel's prophecy against Egypt's pharaoh
keyEvents.description: The prophet Ezekiel proclaimed God's judgment on Egypt's pharaoh and his power, as part of God's punishment of Egypt for their pride and false promises of help.

keyEvents.title: Egypt's fall prophesied by Ezekiel
keyEvents.description: Ezekiel prophesied that Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, would be given Egypt as payment for his service against Tyre, and that Egypt's wealth would be plundered.

keyEvents.title: God's judgment on Egypt and its allies
keyEvents.description: Ezekiel proclaimed that the day of the Lord was near for Egypt, and that God would break Egypt's power and scatter its people among the nations.
